The '''Imperial Training Regiment''' was a organization founded by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Odile Vaiken]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Unlike the rest of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the regiment was made of non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. One of their tasks was to [[Dromund Kaas wilderness campaign|destroy]] the wilderness on Dromund Kaas to pave the way for the construction of [[Kaas City]]. On the site of the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]], Vaiken killed a rabid [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]].
